verdict.rationale: The evidence documents only Microsoft Graph, a proprietary REST API. Its MIME support is limited to sending mail through that API. Nothing shows IMAP, JMAP or SMTP access, or a first-party standards-based export. The only export path is a community-described third-party conversion of .pst files to mbox with readpst, which is a user-side workaround and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a switcher, my mail stays reachable over open protocols and standard formats — IMAP/JMAP/SMTP access and standards-based export — so no client can lock me in
